claims.text: Keratolytics: topical tretinoin 0.1%, or tretinoin 0.05% plus 12% ammonium lactate
claims.quote: topical tretinoin 0.1% or a combination of tretinoin 0.05% and 12% ammonium lactate

claims.text: Topical vitamin D analog calcipotriol (calcipotriene) 0.005% improves lesions
claims.quote: calcipotriol (calcipotriene) 0.005%) act by decreasing keratinocyte proliferation and cause an improvement of the acanthosis nigricans lesions.
The success of these treatments is variable.
